verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for an AI email client, but the pack has no first-party documentation of retention settings, account or data deletion, or control over AI-processed data. A community note says Superhuman stores users' emails on its servers but describes no user control over that. Trashing messages from a sender is ordinary mailbox management, not a retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
